The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit and motion *930to use the record in Barenblatt v. United States, No. 742, October Term, 1956 [354 U. S. 930], are granted. Mr. Justice Burton took no part in the consideration or decision of this application and motion.
